newsitem.title: USA: Grand Casinos sees 1996 Q4 charge.
newsitem.headline: Grand Casinos sees 1996 Q4 charge.

text.p: Grand Casinos Inc said Monday it expects to record a 1996 fourth-quarter charge of between $135 million and $150 million, or $3.15 to $3.50 per share, related to the writeoff of an investment in Stratosphere Corp.

Earlier, the company said it agreed to a Stratosphere restructuring plan. Assuming full subscription in a rights offering, Grand Casinos will contribute about $31.9 million to the reorganized Stratosphere. These shares, plus those received from the conversion of its $50 million of debt, will result in Grand Casinos owning 65 percent of Stratosphere.

Grand Casinos said the additional $75 million of equity contributed to Stratosphere will provide the capital required to complete construction projects, including an additional hotel tower with about 1,000 rooms.
As part of the proposed agreement, Grand Casinos will provide a completion guarantee covering up to $25 million in cost overruns on completion of the additional hotel rooms.
Any amounts paid by Grand Casinos in connection with the completion guarantee would constitute subordinated debt of Stratosphere with interest payable at 11-1/4 percent.

Under terms of the restructuring, the $203 million Stratosphere 14-1/4 percent notes currently outstanding will be exchanged for $203 million of new Stratosphere notes bearing interest at 11-1/4 percent, due May 15, 2002.
The restructuring is subject to several conditions, including plan confirmation by the Federal Bankruptcy Court and resolution of pending securities litigation.

"The proposed restructuring represents a good opportunity for Grand Casinos to control 65 percent of a 2,500-room casino, hotel and one-of-a-kind attraction on the Las Vegas Strip," said Grand Casinos chairman Lyle Berman.
